question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **become**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the different forms of "become."
 
 
• **Becomes**: Used when referring to the third person singular subject.
 
• **Became**: 2nd form of "become" and is used in the past tense.
 
• **Become**: Begin to be. Used in the present tense.
 
• **Becoming**: "verb+ing" used in the continuous tense.
 
 
 
• In this sentence "**has**' is already used and we use "has+verb+ing" in the present perfect tense.
 
• The present perfect tense is used to show an action that happened in the past that is directly related to the present, such as actions that are still continuing or that indicate a change over time.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Due to varying internal and exterior demands, academic life has become difficult for students.
 
• As per the context of the sentence the present perfect tense should be used.
 
• So, "**become**" is the correct word choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete passage:** *Academic life has** (1) become __**demanding for students as a result of different internal and external expectations. Teenagers are especially (2) __ __ to academic stress because they go through so many personal and social changes. As a result, designing effective and efficient (3) __ __ solutions requires a thorough understanding of the causes and consequences of academic stress. Exams are one of the (4) __ __ aspects of anyone's life. Exams are stressful for everyone, whether they are students or adults because everyone wants to perform well and no one wants to fail as to avoid (5) __ __ in future.*
